_what: Every intentional vulnerability in the kit's test fixtures and the finding it is expected to raise, so a known seed is told apart from a new alert without ignoring any directory (owner 2026-11-19). Checked by scripts/fixture_seeds.py check (tree) and classify (alerts); held in self-test. Change it only by a reviewed edit: scripts/fixture_seeds.py propose prints what a fresh scan implies and writes nothing.
_binds: tests/consumer-fixture/SEED_PINS.json (content hashes and named seed pins)
_scope: every dependency manifest under tests/ (each pin is a seed or a declared non-seed pin) and every EXPECTED_SIGNALS entry. Out of scope, stated: tests/fixtures/ and tests/corpora/ test inputs that are not dependency manifests (SARIF samples, scanner corpora), which raise no repository alert.
_disposition: This manifest says what is EXPECTED. It is not a dismissal: each organisation evaluates and records its own dispositions under its own governance, alert by alert, never by directory.
